capabilities: Renders ABC tunes in abc-solfa code blocks with per-block Staff, Sol-fa and Rhythm buttons
Adds movable-do sol-fa syllables and Kodály stick rhythm notation as switchable layers
Plays tunes with real instrument recordings, lighting up the current note in each layer
Sets tempo, beat grouping, size and instrument per block or in plugin settings
Hides buttons and shows only the tune when printing or exporting to PDF
disambiguation: Despite the name, it renders full ABC tunes with staff, sol-fa and stick rhythm layers, not sol-fa syllables alone.
extras: Only one ABC plugin can render abc blocks at a time; other ABC plugins must be turned off to use it on plain abc blocks. Playback downloads recordings a note at a time and shows a message when offline. Only the first voice gets syllables; existing w: lyrics are kept with sol-fa as an extra verse.
problem: Obsidian's ABC rendering shows only the staff, so music teachers have no built-in sol-fa or Kodály stick rhythm layers for reading tunes.

relations.evidence: abcjs laid the tune out differently from how the plugin read it

requires.name: midi-js-soundfonts on GitHub Pages (instrument recordings, playback only)

summary: Renders ABC tunes in Obsidian with switchable Kodály sol-fa syllable and stick rhythm notation layers, plus instrument playback.
